issue.title: Obsidian startup smoke check for plugin rollouts
issue.description:
Package the CDP Obsidian startup check as a reusable script that plugin rollouts run.

Nothing in the bob-cli-a2 rollout (or the bob plugins sync docs) launches a real Obsidian before reporting success, so the 1.60.0 relation-index OOM shipped undetected. Package the ad-hoc CDP check used to verify the fix (launch Obsidian with --remote-debugging-port, hook vault reads pre/post layoutReady, count create replays and non-Markdown reads, assert layoutReady within 30s, plugin version, index ready, zero non-Markdown index entries, heap under ~1.5GB, no new Renderer crash reports) as a reusable script that rollouts run before declaring success.

payload.description: startup smoke check would have caught the a2.8 relation-index OOM before rollout

evidence.note: Independent impact from the bob-cli-bp (Day strip) landing: bob-ledger-tools 1.67.0 (bob-plugins af1e691) registered a CodeMirror StateField whose value is {path, day, decorations} but provided it with EditorView.decorations.from(field) without a getter, so the decorations facet received a plain object and EditorView construction threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading isEmpty)'. Obsidian showed 'Failed to open' for every Markdown note (Bryan's screenshot on epic bob-cli-bp note #1). All 3,647 unit tests passed because the suites stub CodeMirror; a jsdom harness with the real CodeMirror state and view packages reproduced the failure on the pre-fix main.js and confirmed the 1.67.1 fix. A rollout smoke check should also open one canonical daily note and one ordinary note in Live Preview and Source mode and assert the editor mounts without an exception, not just startup/layoutReady.
